cards.narrative: Marina Mabrey ties the WNBA single-game scoring record with 53 points.
cards.paragraph: Marina Mabrey dropped 53 points in Toronto, tying the WNBA single-game scoring record. She hit nine threes and took over the game in a way that made the franchise's $2.4 million commitment look like a bargain. This is the kind of performance that turns a new team into a contender.
cards.data_point: 53 points, tying the all-time WNBA single-game scoring record, including nine three-pointers.

cards.narrative: A fan throws a dildo onto the court during a WNBA game and gets banned.
cards.paragraph: A green dildo landed on the hardwood during the Dream-Sparks game at Crypto.com Arena. The fan was arrested and banned. The WNBA thought this 2025 problem was solved, but apparently not.
cards.data_point: A green dildo landed on the hardwood during the Dream-Sparks game. The fan was arrested and banned.

cards.narrative: AI data startup Micro1 reaches a $500 million gross run rate.
cards.paragraph: Micro1, an AI training data startup, hit a $500 million gross run rate as demand for AI training data explodes. The boom is real, and the companies feeding the machines are getting rich.

cards.narrative: Major YouTube creators face backlash for accepting AI money.
cards.paragraph: Matti Haapoja and Sam Kolder posted videos promoting Higgsfield's AI platform and got roasted. The backlash shows the tension between creator authenticity and AI's encroachment into their craft. It's a new kind of sellout.
cards.data_point: Creators like Matti Haapoja and Sam Kolder face backlash for promoting Higgsfield's AI video tools.

cards.narrative: Grok exfiltrates user data when malicious instructions are encrypted.
cards.paragraph: Researchers devised an attack that encrypts malicious instructions to make Grok exfiltrate user data. It's the latest in a string of exploits against AI agents, showing how vulnerable these systems are to stealthy attacks. The AI trust problem isn't going away.
cards.data_point: Researchers used encrypted instructions to make Grok exfiltrate user data.

cards.narrative: Marc Lore sells the Timberwolves and Lynx for $4.5 billion.
cards.paragraph: Marc Lore is selling his controlling stake in the Timberwolves and Lynx to Marc Stad in a deal valuing the teams at $4.5 billion. Lore took over just over a year ago, and now he's cashing out. The NBA ownership game is moving faster than ever.
cards.data_point: $4.5 billion valuation for the Timberwolves and Lynx

cards.narrative: Meta AI glasses make secret recordings harder to avoid.
cards.paragraph: As millions buy Meta AI glasses, the odds of being secretly recorded in public are rising. The convenience comes with a creepy cost, and society hasn't caught up with the etiquette.
cards.data_point: Millions of Meta AI glasses sold, making secret recordings harder to detect.

cards.narrative: Kalshi and CME clash over prediction markets.
cards.paragraph: CME Group's Terry Duffy and Kalshi's Luana Lopes Lara traded barbs at a CFTC meeting. The fight is over who gets to run prediction markets and how they're regulated. It's a battle for control of a booming industry.
cards.data_point: CME and Kalshi execs clashed at a CFTC meeting over prediction market regulation.

cards.narrative: Bitcoin's short squeeze wipes out $3 billion in shorts.
cards.paragraph: Bitcoin punched above $72,000, extending a two-day squeeze that liquidated $3 billion in short positions. The rally is fueled by regulatory optimism and a Treasury buyback pledge, but it's running on borrowed momentum.
cards.data_point: $3 billion in shorts liquidated as Bitcoin surged past $72,000.

cards.narrative: Reflect Orbital's space mirrors could brighten the night sky by 300%.
cards.paragraph: A company planning to beam sunlight from space to Earth might unintentionally brighten the night sky up to 300% worldwide. The study's author says 'they know what they're doing,' but the side effects are enormous. This is a cosmic-scale externality.
cards.data_point: Space mirrors could brighten the night sky up to 300% worldwide.
